title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (10/20): A Night of Lanterns
note_en: Chinese often puts a long description in front of a noun with 的: 表面依旧热闹的贾府 is literally "the on-the-surface-still-lively Jia household." English can't stack that much before a noun, so it moves the description after it ("the Jia household, though on the surface as lively as ever") or into a relative clause; when reading, look for the 的 to find where the description ends and the noun begins.
